_comment: Row-6 per-sample startup-ladder EXTENSION, mismatch instrument (issue #244 AC 4c/4e).
The first mismatch draw (seed 244, N=400) graded yield 0.9125 with sample_size.verdict
insufficient (observed half-width 0.0289 > 0.01; the grader requires n >= 3068 at that
yield). The plan's rule applies: extend with a NEW seed, never argue around. This is
that extension: seed 245 (fixed before submission, never tuned after seeing a sample),
N = 4200 -- sized so the verdict stays sufficient across the whole 400-sample
Clopper-Pearson interval of the first draw (p as low as 0.874 still gives a half-width
<= 0.01 at N = 4200; the grader's own required_n at p = 0.9125 is 3068). Same decision
rung RREF 71k, Vctrl 1.65 V, seed_scope shared. I_nom for each die comes from the
seed_scope shared makes sample k the same die in both requests (the anchor-1
S1-vs-knownbad control pairing pattern). The 400-sample first draw stays committed
evidence (evidence-r6-ladder-mismatch/) -- this extension is a new record, not a
engine_version 47 is the fail-closed post-run pin; the body carries selft=0.
